revision_reason: The first two executions failed before producing any snapshot because Uncertainty V1 generated prior-predictive near-monopolies and the initial vector allocator included zero-vote lists. V1.1 adopts the already-frozen and successfully calibrated robust Uncertainty V2, exact active-list availability, and explicit marginalization over unknown statutory age tie-breaks.

registered_N.sampler: Regenerate constrained logistic-normal slack draws from frozen per-territory floors/centres and region/local scales; every draw is 92 positive integers summing exactly to the national total.
registered_N.later_official_counts: Require a new snapshot; F-1 is never overwritten.

valid_vote_observation_model.local: For each territory compute 2011 valid-list votes divided by registered-times-turnout; winsorize at empirical p05/p95 and shrink 50% toward the national median.
valid_vote_observation_model.regional: Persist the 2021 regional-to-summed-local valid-vote ratio by region after empirical p05/p95 winsorization and 50% shrinkage toward 1.0; cap at sampled regional N.
valid_vote_observation_model.uncertainty: No additional invalid-ballot-rate shock in F-1; disclosed structural limitation.

legal_party_mapping.eligible_lists: Only party/list codes with positive 2021 votes in that contest are eligible in F-1.
legal_party_mapping.absent_core_mass: Drop core buckets absent from the 2021 contest and renormalize over observed lists.
legal_party_mapping.other_rule: Split OTHER into actual positive-vote 2021 minor-party codes in proportion to their 2021 votes.
legal_party_mapping.active_list_projection: Apply the same 0.0005 floor and 0.6831613228029326 cap after active-list renormalization.
legal_party_mapping.future_new_lists: Excluded from F-1; verified 2026 entries belong to B2/F0 or later immutable snapshots.

integer_vote_model.method: Assign one structural support vote to every observed 2021 eligible list, then use balanced randomized rounding for all remaining valid votes.
integer_vote_model.support_vote_reason: A filed list receiving exactly zero valid votes is treated as outside the structural support of F-1; this prevents numerical tail truncation from manufacturing unique-list/unfilled-seat exceptions.
integer_vote_model.precondition: Every contest must have at least its seat magnitude in observed eligible lists and simulated valid votes must exceed eligible-list count; otherwise fail closed.
integer_vote_model.rounding: Floor expected remaining party counts and assign the exact remainder by Gumbel-top-k weighted by fractional parts.
integer_vote_model.unique_or_unfilled_policy: Any UNIQUE_LIST_THRESHOLD_NOT_MET or UNFILLED_SEATS_EXCEPTIONAL state is a model failure and blocks F-1.

statutory_tie_uncertainty.law: A binding equal-remainder tie is legally resolved by the relevant candidate age, then lottery on equal age.
statutory_tie_uncertainty.F_minus_1_information_state: Candidate ages are intentionally absent from this structural-only snapshot.
statutory_tie_uncertainty.implementation: For each binding tied remainder group, draw uniformly without replacement the required number of lists using a dedicated frozen RNG stream; this marginalizes unknown age ordering and is not labelled a deterministic legal winner.
statutory_tie_uncertainty.later_replacement: Verified candidate ages may replace the exchangeable prior only in a new B2/F0-or-later snapshot.
mandatory_reporting: number and rate of contest-draws using the age prior

regional_ballot_bridge.latent_shift: Same national and region vote innovations as local contests plus the mean sampled local residual within the region.
regional_ballot_bridge.limitation: No pre-2021 current-system regional-list transition exists; 2026 is the first prospective test.

required_invariants: 92 local N are positive integers and sum exactly to 15,801,162
all local and regional share vectors are finite, non-negative and sum to one
all simulated vote counts are non-negative integers and do not exceed registered N
all 104 contests allocate exactly their configured seats
every national draw sums to 395 seats
zero unique-list threshold failures and zero unfilled-seat exceptions
zero unresolved statutory ties after exchangeable-age marginalization
